mapper.select: SELECT result_id, job_id, content, item_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM crawling_result ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT result_id, job_id, content, item_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM crawling_result WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawling_result (job_id, content, item_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{content}, #{itemCount}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM crawling_result WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
